chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Dāwūd al-ʿIjlī, the mawlā of Abū al-Miʿzā, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “O Abā Muḥammad, whoever performs wudu (ablution) and mentions the name of Allah, Exalted is He, his entire body is purified; and whoever does not mention [His name], nothing of his body is purified except that which the water reaches.”

key_terms.اسْمَ اللَّهِ: the name of Allah, invoked at the time of purification

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of saying the name of Allah during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the importance of mentioning the name of Allah during wudu (ablution). It indicates that saying Allah’s name perfects and extends the purification, while omitting it limits purification to only what the water physically touches.
